diff --git a/durability.go b/durability.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..65a4aee8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/durability.go
@@ -0,0 +1,502 @@
+// Copyright 2026 The LevelDB-Go and Pebble Authors. All rights reserved. Use
+// of this source code is governed by a BSD-style license that can be found in
+// the LICENSE file.
+
+package pebble
+
+import (
+	"container/heap"
+	"context"
+	"reflect"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/crlib/crtime"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/errors"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/pebble/internal/base"
+	"github.com/cockroachdb/redact"
+)
+
+// BatchDurableInfo contains the info for a BatchDurable event.
+type BatchDurableInfo struct {
+	// JobID is the ID of the durability job. It can be passed to
+	// DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	JobID int
+	// SeqNum is the sequence number of the committed batch.
+	SeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// Err is non-nil if the commit or the WAL sync failed.
+	Err error
+	// ApplyDuration is the time spent applying the batch to the memtable.
+	ApplyDuration time.Duration
+	// SyncDuration is the time between writing the batch to the WAL and the
+	// completion of the WAL sync.
+	SyncDuration time.Duration
+	// CorrelationID is WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID of the commit.
+	CorrelationID uint64
+	// BatchSize is the size of the encoded batch in bytes.
+	BatchSize int
+	// KeyCount is the number of keys in the batch.
+	KeyCount uint32
+}
+
+func (i BatchDurableInfo) String() string {
+	return redact.StringWithoutMarkers(i)
+}
+
+// SafeFormat implements redact.SafeFormatter.
+func (i BatchDurableInfo) SafeFormat(w redact.SafePrinter, _ rune) {
+	if i.Err != nil {
+		w.Printf("[JOB %d] batch durable error: seqnum %d: %s",
+			redact.Safe(i.JobID), redact.Safe(i.SeqNum), i.Err)
+		return
+	}
+	w.Printf("[JOB %d] batch durable: seqnum %d, %d keys, %d bytes; apply %s, sync %s",
+		redact.Safe(i.JobID), redact.Safe(i.SeqNum), redact.Safe(i.KeyCount),
+		redact.Safe(i.BatchSize), redact.Safe(i.ApplyDuration), redact.Safe(i.SyncDuration))
+}
+
+// noopBatchDurable is the default BatchDurable handler installed by
+// EventListener.EnsureDefaults. It is a named function so that the DB can
+// determine whether a real handler has been configured.
+func noopBatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo) {}
+
+func isNoopBatchDurable(f func(BatchDurableInfo)) bool {
+	return f == nil ||
+		reflect.ValueOf(f).Pointer() == reflect.ValueOf(noopBatchDurable).Pointer()
+}
+
+func teeBatchDurable(a, b func(BatchDurableInfo)) func(BatchDurableInfo) {
+	switch {
+	case isNoopBatchDurable(a) && isNoopBatchDurable(b):
+		return noopBatchDurable
+	case isNoopBatchDurable(a):
+		return b
+	case isNoopBatchDurable(b):
+		return a
+	}
+	return func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+		a(info)
+		b(info)
+	}
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats is a snapshot of the durability tracking state of a DB.
+type DurabilityStats struct {
+	// HighestDurableSeqNum is the highest sequence number known to be durable.
+	HighestDurableSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	// FirstErr is the first WAL sync error observed, if any.
+	FirstErr error
+	// PendingWaiters is the number of goroutines currently blocked in the
+	// durability wait APIs.
+	PendingWaiters int64
+	// TotalDurableCommits is the number of Sync commits whose WAL sync
+	// succeeded.
+	TotalDurableCommits uint64
+	// TotalFailedCommits is the number of Sync commits that failed.
+	TotalFailedCommits uint64
+	// CumulativeSyncDuration is the sum of the WAL sync durations of the
+	// successful Sync commits.
+	CumulativeSyncDuration time.Duration
+	// MaxSyncDuration is the largest WAL sync duration of a successful Sync
+	// commit.
+	MaxSyncDuration time.Duration
+}
+
+var (
+	// ErrDurabilityJobExpired is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+	// job ID is outside of the retention window.
+	ErrDurabilityJobExpired = errors.New("pebble: durability job expired")
+	// ErrDurabilityJobUnknown is returned by DB.WaitForJobDurability when the
+	// job ID was never assigned.
+	ErrDurabilityJobUnknown = errors.New("pebble: unknown durability job")
+	// ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions is delivered by DB.DurabilityNotify
+	// when the number of outstanding subscriptions exceeds the limit.
+	ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions = errors.New("pebble: too many outstanding durability subscriptions")
+)
+
+const (
+	// durabilityJobRetention is the number of most recent durability jobs whose
+	// outcome is retained for DB.WaitForJobDurability.
+	durabilityJobRetention = 1024
+	// maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions bounds the number of outstanding
+	// DB.DurabilityNotify subscriptions.
+	maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions = 1024
+)
+
+type durabilityJob struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	err    error
+}
+
+type durabilityWaiter struct {
+	seqNum base.SeqNum
+	ch     chan error
+	notify bool
+	// index is the position of the waiter in the heap, or -1 if the waiter
+	// has been removed.
+	index int
+}
+
+// durabilityWaiterHeap is a min-heap of waiters ordered by sequence number.
+type durabilityWaiterHeap []*durabilityWaiter
+
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Len() int           { return len(h) }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Less(i, j int) bool { return h[i].seqNum < h[j].seqNum }
+func (h durabilityWaiterHeap) Swap(i, j int) {
+	h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i]
+	h[i].index = i
+	h[j].index = j
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Push(x any) {
+	w := x.(*durabilityWaiter)
+	w.index = len(*h)
+	*h = append(*h, w)
+}
+func (h *durabilityWaiterHeap) Pop() any {
+	old := *h
+	n := len(old)
+	w := old[n-1]
+	old[n-1] = nil
+	w.index = -1
+	*h = old[:n-1]
+	return w
+}
+
+// durabilityTracker tracks which sequence numbers are known to be durable and
+// allows goroutines to wait for durability. The zero value is ready to use.
+type durabilityTracker struct {
+	// anyCommit is set once any commit has completed. It is used to satisfy
+	// waits for sequence number zero.
+	anyCommit atomic.Bool
+	// pendingWaiters is the number of goroutines blocked in wait.
+	pendingWaiters atomic.Int64
+
+	mu struct {
+		sync.Mutex
+		highest  base.SeqNum
+		firstErr error
+		closeErr error
+		waiters  durabilityWaiterHeap
+		// notifySubs is the number of outstanding DurabilityNotify
+		// subscriptions.
+		notifySubs int
+		// lastJobID is the most recently assigned job ID; job IDs start at 1.
+		lastJobID int
+		jobs      [durabilityJobRetention]durabilityJob
+
+		totalDurable    uint64
+		totalFailed     uint64
+		cumSyncDuration time.Duration
+		maxSyncDuration time.Duration
+
+		// Metrics accumulated only when EventListener.BatchDurable is
+		// configured.
+		metricCount    uint64
+		metricDuration time.Duration
+	}
+}
+
+// satisfiedLocked returns the result of a wait for seqNum and whether the wait
+// is complete.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) satisfiedLocked(seqNum base.SeqNum) (error, bool) {
+	if seqNum == 0 {
+		if t.anyCommit.Load() {
+			return nil, true
+		}
+	} else if t.mu.highest >= seqNum {
+		return nil, true
+	}
+	if t.mu.firstErr != nil {
+		return t.mu.firstErr, true
+	}
+	if t.mu.closeErr != nil {
+		return t.mu.closeErr, true
+	}
+	return nil, false
+}
+
+// releaseLocked delivers err to w, which must already have been removed from
+// the heap.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) releaseLocked(w *durabilityWaiter, err error) {
+	if w.notify {
+		t.mu.notifySubs--
+	}
+	w.ch <- err
+}
+
+// wakeLocked releases all waiters whose wait is complete.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wakeLocked() {
+	for len(t.mu.waiters) > 0 {
+		err, ok := t.satisfiedLocked(t.mu.waiters[0].seqNum)
+		if !ok {
+			// Waiters are ordered by seqnum, and errors release all waiters,
+			// so no subsequent waiter can be satisfied either.
+			return
+		}
+		t.releaseLocked(heap.Pop(&t.mu.waiters).(*durabilityWaiter), err)
+	}
+}
+
+// noteCommit records that a (non-Sync) commit has completed.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) noteCommit() {
+	if t.anyCommit.Load() {
+		return
+	}
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	t.anyCommit.Store(true)
+	t.wakeLocked()
+}
+
+// record records the outcome of a Sync commit and returns the job ID assigned
+// to it.
+func (t *durabilityTracker) record(
+	seqNum, lastSeqNum base.SeqNum, err error, syncDuration time.Duration, trackMetrics bool,
+) int {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	t.mu.lastJobID++
+	jobID := t.mu.lastJobID
+	t.mu.jobs[jobID%durabilityJobRetention] = durabilityJob{seqNum: seqNum, err: err}
+	if err != nil {
+		t.mu.totalFailed++
+		if t.mu.firstErr == nil {
+			t.mu.firstErr = err
+		}
+	} else {
+		t.mu.totalDurable++
+		t.mu.cumSyncDuration += syncDuration
+		t.mu.maxSyncDuration = max(t.mu.maxSyncDuration, syncDuration)
+		if trackMetrics {
+			t.mu.metricCount++
+			t.mu.metricDuration += syncDuration
+		}
+		// The WAL is written and synced sequentially, so the sync of this
+		// batch implies all lower sequence numbers are durable too.
+		t.mu.highest = max(t.mu.highest, lastSeqNum)
+	}
+	t.anyCommit.Store(true)
+	t.wakeLocked()
+	return jobID
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) close(err error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if t.mu.closeErr == nil {
+		t.mu.closeErr = err
+	}
+	t.wakeLocked()
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) wait(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	if err, ok := t.satisfiedLocked(seqNum); ok {
+		t.mu.Unlock()
+		return err
+	}
+	w := &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: make(chan error, 1)}
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, w)
+	t.pendingWaiters.Add(1)
+	t.mu.Unlock()
+	defer t.pendingWaiters.Add(-1)
+
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	case <-ctx.Done():
+	}
+
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if w.index >= 0 {
+		heap.Remove(&t.mu.waiters, w.index)
+		w.index = -1
+	}
+	// Durability and close errors take precedence over context cancellation.
+	select {
+	case err := <-w.ch:
+		return err
+	default:
+	}
+	if err, ok := t.satisfiedLocked(seqNum); ok {
+		return err
+	}
+	return ctx.Err()
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) notify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	ch := make(chan error, 1)
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	if err, ok := t.satisfiedLocked(seqNum); ok {
+		ch <- err
+		return ch
+	}
+	if t.mu.notifySubs >= maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions {
+		ch <- ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions
+		return ch
+	}
+	t.mu.notifySubs++
+	heap.Push(&t.mu.waiters, &durabilityWaiter{seqNum: seqNum, ch: ch, notify: true})
+	return ch
+}
+
+func (t *durabilityTracker) job(jobID int) (durabilityJob, error) {
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	switch {
+	case jobID <= 0 || jobID > t.mu.lastJobID:
+		return durabilityJob{}, errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobUnknown, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+	case jobID <= t.mu.lastJobID-durabilityJobRetention:
+		return durabilityJob{}, errors.Wrapf(ErrDurabilityJobExpired, "job %d", errors.Safe(jobID))
+	}
+	return t.mu.jobs[jobID%durabilityJobRetention], nil
+}
+
+// batchDurableState is embedded in Batch and carries the information needed to
+// fire a BatchDurable event for a Sync commit.
+type batchDurableState struct {
+	// db is set for successful ApplyNoSyncWait commits whose event will be
+	// fired from Batch.SyncWait.
+	db            *DB
+	fired         bool
+	walStart      crtime.Mono
+	applyDuration time.Duration
+	batchSize     int
+	keyCount      uint32
+	correlationID uint64
+}
+
+// fireBatchDurable records the outcome of a Sync commit of b and invokes the
+// BatchDurable event listener. It must be called exactly once per Sync commit,
+// after the WAL sync has completed.
+func (d *DB) fireBatchDurable(b *Batch, err error) {
+	syncDuration := time.Duration(1)
+	if b.durable.walStart != 0 {
+		syncDuration = max(b.durable.walStart.Elapsed(), syncDuration)
+	}
+	applyDuration := max(b.durable.applyDuration, time.Duration(1))
+	seqNum := b.SeqNum()
+	lastSeqNum := seqNum
+	if n := b.durable.keyCount; n > 0 {
+		lastSeqNum = seqNum + base.SeqNum(n) - 1
+	}
+	jobID := d.durability.record(seqNum, lastSeqNum, err, syncDuration, d.batchDurableConfigured)
+	d.opts.EventListener.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{
+		JobID:         jobID,
+		SeqNum:        seqNum,
+		Err:           err,
+		ApplyDuration: applyDuration,
+		SyncDuration:  syncDuration,
+		CorrelationID: b.durable.correlationID,
+		BatchSize:     b.durable.batchSize,
+		KeyCount:      b.durable.keyCount,
+	})
+}
+
+// WaitForDurability blocks until the provided sequence number is durable. A
+// sequence number of zero is satisfied once any commit has completed. It
+// returns an error if a WAL sync fails or the DB is closed before the sequence
+// number becomes durable. If the WAL is disabled, it returns nil immediately.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurability(seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityContext(context.Background(), seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityContext is like WaitForDurability, but also returns if the
+// context is canceled. Durability and close errors take precedence over the
+// context's error.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, seqNum base.SeqNum) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, seqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatch blocks until every sequence number in seqNums is
+// durable. It returns nil if seqNums is empty.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatch(seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	return d.WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(context.Background(), seqNums)
+}
+
+// WaitForDurabilityBatchContext is like WaitForDurabilityBatch, but also
+// returns if the context is canceled. Durability and close errors take
+// precedence over the context's error.
+func (d *DB) WaitForDurabilityBatchContext(ctx context.Context, seqNums []base.SeqNum) error {
+	if len(seqNums) == 0 || d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	// Durability is monotonic, so waiting for the largest sequence number is
+	// sufficient.
+	var maxSeqNum base.SeqNum
+	for _, s := range seqNums {
+		maxSeqNum = max(maxSeqNum, s)
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, maxSeqNum)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurability blocks until the Sync commit identified by the
+// BatchDurableInfo.JobID is durable, returning the commit's error. Job IDs
+// outside of the retention window return an error wrapping
+// ErrDurabilityJobExpired; job IDs that were never assigned (including zero)
+// return an error wrapping ErrDurabilityJobUnknown.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurability(jobID int) error {
+	return d.WaitForJobDurabilityContext(context.Background(), jobID)
+}
+
+// WaitForJobDurabilityContext is like WaitForJobDurability, but also returns if
+// the context is canceled. Durability and close errors take precedence over
+// the context's error.
+func (d *DB) WaitForJobDurabilityContext(ctx context.Context, jobID int) error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		return nil
+	}
+	j, err := d.durability.job(jobID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if j.err != nil {
+		return j.err
+	}
+	return d.durability.wait(ctx, j.seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurableState returns the highest sequence number known to be durable and
+// the first WAL sync error observed, if any.
+func (d *DB) DurableState() (base.SeqNum, error) {
+	d.durability.mu.Lock()
+	defer d.durability.mu.Unlock()
+	return d.durability.mu.highest, d.durability.mu.firstErr
+}
+
+// DurabilityNotify returns a channel that receives a single value once the
+// provided sequence number is durable: nil on success, or a non-nil error if a
+// WAL sync fails or the DB is closed first. If the number of outstanding
+// subscriptions exceeds an internal limit, the returned channel immediately
+// delivers ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions. If the WAL is disabled, the
+// channel immediately delivers nil.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityNotify(seqNum base.SeqNum) <-chan error {
+	if d.opts.DisableWAL {
+		ch := make(chan error, 1)
+		ch <- nil
+		return ch
+	}
+	return d.durability.notify(seqNum)
+}
+
+// DurabilityStats returns a snapshot of the durability tracking state.
+func (d *DB) DurabilityStats() DurabilityStats {
+	t := &d.durability
+	t.mu.Lock()
+	defer t.mu.Unlock()
+	return DurabilityStats{
+		HighestDurableSeqNum:   t.mu.highest,
+		FirstErr:               t.mu.firstErr,
+		PendingWaiters:         t.pendingWaiters.Load(),
+		TotalDurableCommits:    t.mu.totalDurable,
+		TotalFailedCommits:     t.mu.totalFailed,
+		CumulativeSyncDuration: t.mu.cumSyncDuration,
+		MaxSyncDuration:        t.mu.maxSyncDuration,
+	}
+}

+func openDurabilityTestDB(t *testing.T, disableWAL bool, listener func(BatchDurableInfo)) *DB {
+	opts := &Options{FS: vfs.NewMem(), DisableWAL: disableWAL}
+	if listener != nil {
+		opts.EventListener = &EventListener{BatchDurable: listener}
+	}
+	d, err := Open("", opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return d
+}
+
+func TestBatchDurableEvent(t *testing.T) {
+	var mu sync.Mutex
+	var infos []BatchDurableInfo
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, false, func(info BatchDurableInfo) {
+		mu.Lock()
+		defer mu.Unlock()
+		infos = append(infos, info)
+	})
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+
+	// Non-sync commits never fire.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), []byte("1"), NoSync))
+	require.Empty(t, infos)
+
+	b := d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("b"), []byte("2"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("c"), []byte("3"), nil))
+	size := len(b.Repr())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Commit(&WriteOptions{Sync: true, CommitCorrelationID: 42}))
+	seq := b.SeqNum()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+
+	require.Len(t, infos, 1)
+	info := infos[0]
+	require.NoError(t, info.Err)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, info.JobID)
+	require.Equal(t, seq, info.SeqNum)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(42), info.CorrelationID)
+	require.Equal(t, size, info.BatchSize)
+	require.Equal(t, uint32(2), info.KeyCount)
+	require.Greater(t, info.ApplyDuration, time.Duration(0))
+	require.Greater(t, info.SyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(seq))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(seq+1))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(info.JobID))
+	highest, err := d.DurableState()
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, seq+1, highest)
+
+	// ApplyNoSyncWait fires from SyncWait.
+	b = d.NewBatch()
+	require.NoError(t, b.Set([]byte("d"), []byte("4"), nil))
+	require.NoError(t, d.ApplyNoSyncWait(b, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, b.SyncWait())
+	require.NoError(t, b.Close())
+	require.Len(t, infos, 2)
+	require.Equal(t, 2, infos[1].JobID)
+
+	m := d.Metrics()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(2), m.DurableCommitCount)
+	require.Greater(t, m.DurableCommitDuration, time.Duration(0))
+
+	s := d.DurabilityStats()
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(2), s.TotalDurableCommits)
+	require.Zero(t, s.TotalFailedCommits)
+	require.Zero(t, s.PendingWaiters)
+	require.Equal(t, m.DurableCommitDuration, s.CumulativeSyncDuration)
+	require.Greater(t, s.MaxSyncDuration, time.Duration(0))
+}

+func TestDurabilityNoListener(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, false, nil)
+	require.Equal(t, DurabilityStats{}, d.DurabilityStats())
+
+	err := d.WaitForJobDurability(0)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrDurabilityJobUnknown)
+	require.Contains(t, err.Error(), "unknown")
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(1), ErrDurabilityJobUnknown)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch(nil))
+
+	// Seqnum zero blocks until any commit.
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, 0), context.DeadlineExceeded)
+
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), nil, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(0))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(1))
+	// Metrics are not accumulated without a configured listener.
+	require.Zero(t, d.Metrics().DurableCommitCount)
+	require.Equal(t, uint64(1), d.DurabilityStats().TotalDurableCommits)
+
+	for i := 0; i < durabilityJobRetention+1; i++ {
+		require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), nil, Sync))
+	}
+	err = d.WaitForJobDurability(1)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrDurabilityJobExpired)
+	require.Contains(t, err.Error(), "expired")
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(durabilityJobRetention+2))
+
+	// Blocked waiters and notifications are released with an error on close.
+	highest, _ := d.DurableState()
+	future := highest + 100
+	ch := d.DurabilityNotify(future)
+	done := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { done <- d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{highest, future}) }()
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1 },
+		10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+	require.NoError(t, <-d.DurabilityNotify(highest))
+	require.NoError(t, d.Close())
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-done, ErrClosed)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-ch, ErrClosed)
+	require.Zero(t, d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters)
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityWaitUnblocksOnCommit(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, false, nil)
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), nil, Sync))
+	highest, _ := d.DurableState()
+
+	done := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() { done <- d.WaitForDurability(highest + 2) }()
+	ch := d.DurabilityNotify(highest + 2)
+	require.Eventually(t, func() bool { return d.DurabilityStats().PendingWaiters == 1 },
+		10*time.Second, time.Millisecond)
+	// Non-sync writes don't make anything durable, but a subsequent sync does.
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("b"), nil, NoSync))
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("c"), nil, Sync))
+	require.NoError(t, <-done)
+	require.NoError(t, <-ch)
+
+	// Context cancellation.
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, highest+100), context.Canceled)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityContext(ctx, highest))
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityNotifyBound(t *testing.T) {
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, false, nil)
+	var chs []<-chan error
+	for i := 0; i < maxDurabilityNotifySubscriptions; i++ {
+		chs = append(chs, d.DurabilityNotify(1000))
+	}
+	select {
+	case err := <-d.DurabilityNotify(1000):
+		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrTooManyDurabilitySubscriptions)
+	default:
+		t.Fatal("expected pre-filled channel")
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, d.Close())
+	for _, ch := range chs {
+		require.Error(t, <-ch)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityDisableWAL(t *testing.T) {
+	fired := false
+	d := openDurabilityTestDB(t, true, func(BatchDurableInfo) { fired = true })
+	defer func() { require.NoError(t, d.Close()) }()
+	require.NoError(t, d.Set([]byte("a"), nil, NoSync))
+	require.False(t, fired)
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurability(1000))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForDurabilityBatch([]base.SeqNum{1, 1000}))
+	require.NoError(t, d.WaitForJobDurability(5))
+	require.NoError(t, <-d.DurabilityNotify(1000))
+	require.Equal(t, DurabilityStats{}, d.DurabilityStats())
+}
+
+func TestDurabilityTrackerError(t *testing.T) {
+	var tr durabilityTracker
+	syncErr := errors.New("sync failed")
+	ch := tr.notify(20)
+	jobID := tr.record(10, 11, nil, time.Millisecond, false)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, jobID)
+	require.Equal(t, 2, tr.record(12, 12, syncErr, time.Millisecond, false))
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-ch, syncErr)
+	require.NoError(t, tr.wait(context.Background(), 11))
+	require.ErrorIs(t, tr.wait(context.Background(), 12), syncErr)
+	// Errors take precedence over cancellation.
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, tr.wait(ctx, 100), syncErr)
+}

+func TestTeeBatchDurable(t *testing.T) {
+	require.True(t, isNoopBatchDurable(TeeEventListener(EventListener{}, EventListener{}).BatchDurable))
+	var a, b int
+	l := TeeEventListener(
+		EventListener{BatchDurable: func(BatchDurableInfo) { a++ }},
+		EventListener{BatchDurable: func(BatchDurableInfo) { b++ }})
+	require.False(t, isNoopBatchDurable(l.BatchDurable))
+	l.BatchDurable(BatchDurableInfo{})
+	require.Equal(t, 1, a)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, b)
+}
